$comment: 听力训练营 L12（P-L2）。脚本 100% 原创；阶段二 · Part 4 主旨三选一（5 段，主旨直白）+ Part 2 笔记填空（一段独白 5 空，本课只填数字和时间）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 0.9x。
title: School Radio
intro: 学校广播站的一天：先听五段校园短话，每段只问「在讲什么」；再听一段运动会通知，把笔记里的五个数字和时间补上。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: Good morning, everyone. Tomorrow is school photo day, so please come in your full uniform.
Class photos are at ten, and you can buy a copy for your family next week.

questions.q: What is the woman talking about?
questions.explain: 第一句就点题 tomorrow is school photo day，后面 uniform / class photos / buy a copy 都围绕拍照。老师和校车都没提。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出他们在讲什么。

script.text: Anna, did you do the maths homework? I can't do question five.
Yes, I finished it last night. Question five is about the shapes.
Can you show me at break? I don't want to get it wrong.
Sure, meet me in the library at half past ten.

questions.q: What are Tom and Anna talking about?
questions.explain: 开头 did you do the maths homework，后面 question five / finished it / show me 都是在说作业。没有考试，也没有新老师。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: Here's the sports news. On Saturday our football team played Hill School and won three-one!
Ben scored two goals and Lucy scored one. Well done, everyone, the next match is at home on Friday.

questions.q: What is the boy talking about?
options: a match the school team won
questions.explain: sports news / played Hill School / won three-one / scored goals——整段是在报一场赢了的比赛。体育馆和足球课都没出现。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: A message from the library. The library is closed all this week because the walls are being painted.
If you need to give a book back, put it in the box by the office. We open again next Monday.

questions.q: What is the man telling the students?
options: The library is closed this week.
There are new books in the library.
questions.explain: closed all this week + being painted + open again next Monday，讲的是本周关门。没说新书，也不是今天晚点开。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出他们在讲什么。

script.text: Ben, have you seen the menu today? It's pizza day!
Great, I love pizza. Is there any salad with it?
Yes, and there's apple cake after. Let's go early before the queue gets long.
OK, I'll meet you at the door at twelve.

questions.q: What are Mia and Ben talking about?
questions.explain: the menu today / pizza day / salad / apple cake / queue——说的是学校今天的午饭。不是餐厅，也不是在家做饭。

sections.intro: 听一段学校广播通知，把笔记补全。每个空填一个数字或一个时间。

script.text: Hello, everyone, this is Mrs Green with some news about Sports Day on Friday.
Sports Day starts at half past nine, not nine o'clock as it says on the poster, so please be on the field by quarter past nine.
This year there are six teams, not four, so every team has a colour: red, blue, green, yellow, white and black.
The longest race is eight hundred metres. Last year it was four hundred, but you are all older now!
Lunch is at quarter past twelve, and your parents can come and watch from two o'clock.
It will be hot, so bring two bottles of water, and a hat. See you on Friday!

questions.explain: starts at half past nine = 9:30。nine o'clock 是海报上写错的时间，quarter past nine 是到场时间。
there are six teams, not four。four 被 not 否定。
the longest race is eight hundred metres = 800。four hundred 是去年的。
lunch is at quarter past twelve = 12:15。two o'clock 是家长来看的时间。
bring two bottles of water = 2，每人带两瓶水。
